name: Filter — markets (location)
description: Branches pass / fail. Pass when a 'location' field on the request matches a curated market — e.g. 'every airport in the USA except Texas, plus GVA'. Compiles down to a string-IN filter at evaluation time. Source field must be a string field whose name contains 'location' (reserved word).

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The location field to test — pick a string field from your request whose name contains 'location'.

params.name: literal
params.description: The market — author by including/excluding hierarchy levels (continent, country, state, city) plus single airport codes.

params.name: onMissing
params.description: What to do when the source path isn't in the request.
